email_subject: Application - Media Assistant Intern at Comms8
email_body:
Dear Comms8 Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Media Assistant Intern role. Your focus on content creation, business operations, and external outreach matches the work I do daily: building and optimizing websites, writing SEO content, managing WordPress and Shopify stores, and using Canva for visuals. I also edit short videos and have a technical background that helps me pick up new tools quickly.

At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content publishing for client sites, and I've built sites like mirook.com with structured data and AI-search optimization. I'm fluent in English and native in Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, so I can localize content as needed. I'm eager to bring my mix of content, analytics, and hands-on web skills to Comms8's projects.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Comms8 Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Media Assistant Intern position. Your emphasis on content creation, business operations, and external outreach aligns closely with my experience as a digital marketer with a technical background. I build and optimize websites for both traditional and AI-powered search, write content that ranks, and use AI tools and code to automate repetitive work—skills I'm eager to apply to Comms8's projects.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I manage CMS content in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) and Shopify, and I've designed and built sites like mirook.com, where I implemented JSON-LD schema and ran technical SEO/GEO audits. I also use Canva for visual design and have experience editing short videos for social media. My technical background—including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python automation—helps me quickly learn new tools and platforms.

I'm fluent in English and native in Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, so I can localize content across languages as needed. I'm a team player with strong attention to detail and a genuine interest in influencer marketing and digital trends. I'm confident that my mix of content, analytics, and hands-on web skills would let me contribute meaningfully to Comms8's marketing initiatives and stakeholder relationships.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can support your team.

Best regards,
